description: Come chat with Chris Lundberg and his running mate, Rep. Michelle Bos-Lun. Have a conversation over a cup of coffee or tea in Bellows Falls. Hope to see you there! This event is the first in a series of meet-and-greets held at the Flatiron by Chris and Rep. Bos-Lun every Sunday.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Chris Lundberg for State Representative, 19 Prospect St
title: MEET CHRIS AND MICHELLE OVER COFFEE — Chris Lundberg for Vermont House of Representatives
